test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Reckless**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Reckless **means acting without thinking about the consequences, often in a careless or impulsive manner. (परिणामों के बारे में सोचे बिना कार्य करना, अक्सर लापरवाह या आवेगपूर्ण तरीके से​)

 
 
• **Example: ***His reckless driving, weaving in and out of traffic at high speed, led to an accident*.
 
 
 
• In the context of accidents, the word "**reckless**" suggests that these accidents occur due to drivers behaving in a manner that disregards safety and caution, leading to frequent and preventable incidents.

Therefore, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Experimental: **Involving or based on experiments, testing, or experience to gain knowledge. (ज्ञान प्राप्त करने के लिए प्रयोगों, परीक्षण या अनुभव को शामिल करना या उस पर आधारित होना)
 
• **Careful: **Taking heed and paying attention to avoid mistakes or harm; cautious and deliberate in actions. (गलतियों या हानि से बचने के लिए ध्यान रखना और ध्यान देना; कार्यों में सतर्क और विचारशील)
 
• **Rude: **Displaying a lack of politeness or consideration for others; impolite or discourteous behaviour. (दूसरों के प्रति विनम्रता या विचारशीलता की कमी प्रदर्शित करना; अभद्र या असभ्य व्यवहार)
